rules: Ground truth must remain separate from candidate provenance.
Correctness labels must not appear in candidate provenance.
Provenance must represent independently specified source history or relationships.
Candidate text and provenance must be fixed before final model evaluation.
Every method receives the same candidate pool and context budget for a case.
Provenance-enabled frontier conditions receive the same provenance available to BRAID.
The downstream generator is fixed across all methods.
Cases must vary graph topology, information source types, and subject matter.
Cases must represent realistic context encountered by the named AI-system environment.
Cases must not be cosmetic rewrites of development benchmarks.
No case or scoring rule may be modified in response to final benchmark outputs.
